Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Identified standing and sleeping lines using body-position examples.
Identified a slanting line in the letter A and named examples such as a flagpole.
Asha revisited that a tilted line can still be straight; the mix-up remained for lines with corners or bends.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines using familiar examples and movements. They correctly connected standing lines with up-and-down direction and sleeping lines with a flat direction. Asha revisited that slanting means tilted, not curved, but Om still mixed up a tilted straight line with a line that bends. At home, draw one straight line in each direction and ask Om to point out whether it is standing, sleeping or slanting; then compare it with a zigzag.
